_comment: The toolchains this curriculum supports. This file is the single source of truth: rcpp audit checks every lesson's platform claims against it, and the continuous integration matrix is generated from it, so a claim and a lane cannot drift apart. A lesson that needs Qt may only claim a toolchain whose lane installs Qt, otherwise it would be silently skipped there and a skip looks exactly like a pass.

toolchains.name: ubuntu-22.04 gcc-11
toolchains.note: The floor. C++17 is complete here, which is why the curriculum targets it.

toolchains.name: ubuntu-22.04 clang-14
toolchains.note: A second front end, which catches what one compiler accepts by accident.

toolchains.name: windows msvc-2022
toolchains.note: Qt is installed on this lane from the official archive, so Qt lessons may claim it.
